राजकुमार राव की फिल्म Prahaar का सफर बॉक्स ऑफिस पर सिमट गया है! 📉
यह बायोग्राफिकल लीगल ड्रामा 16 अक्टूबर 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हुआ था। 🎬
फिल्म ने घरेलू बॉक्स ऑफिस पर 23.82 करोड़ नेट यानी 28.11 करोड़ ग्रॉस की कमाई की। 💰
ओवरसीज मार्केट में फिल्म ने 3.03 करोड़ ग्रॉस कमाए, जिससे कुल वर्ल्डवाइड कलेक्शन 31.14 करोड़ ग्रॉस पर बंद हुआ। 🌍
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, Maddock Films के बैनर तले बनी इस फिल्म का बजट 60 करोड़ था। 💸
कम बजट वसूली के चलते फिल्म को 36.18 करोड़ यानी साठ प्रतिशत का घाटा हुआ और यह फ्लॉप साबित हुई। 🛑
क्या आपने सिनेमाघर जाकर यह फिल्म देखी थी? 🍿

ctx.title: Prahaar Box Office (Closing Collection): Rajkummar Rao Starrer Ends Its Disappointing Run With 60% Deficit
ctx.summary:
Rajkummar Rao-led Prahaar wrapped up its box office run in just three weeks, earning a highly disappointing total of below 32 crore worldwide. 
 The post  Prahaar Box Office (Closing Collection): Rajkummar Rao Starrer Ends Its Disappointing Run With 60% Deficit  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Rajkummar Rao-led Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam, aka Prahaar, was expected to do well in the long run, but unfortunately it didn’t, as word-of-mouth was average. Based on Public Prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam’s role in legal battles surrounding the 1993 Bombay bombings and 2008 Mumbai attacks, the film couldn’t pique audience interest and found no takers at the worldwide box office. With Ramayana releasing on Thursday (November 5), it technically wrapped up its run.
The biographical legal drama was released theatrically on October 16, 2026. It opened to decent-to-average reviews from critics. Rajkummar Rao and Lalit Prabhakar were praised for their performances, while the film, as a whole, received criticism for its uneven screenplay and pacing issues. Among audiences, it failed to create any urgency.
Prahaar finished its domestic run with 23.82 crore net, which equals 28.11 crore gross. Overseas, too, it was a passable affair, with a 3.03 crore gross. Overall, the closing worldwide box office collection stands at 31.14 crore gross. Considering Maddock Films’ banner, the total came as a shocker.
Prahaar was reportedly made on a budget of 60 crore . Against this cost, it earned only 23.82 crore net, thus recovering only 39.7% of its budget. It suffered a deficit of 36.18 crore , or 60.3% . With such a deficit, the film finished its run with a flop verdict at the Indian box office. It’s another setback for Rajkummar Rao after Maalik .
Prahaar is directed by Avinash Arun and produced by Dinesh Vijan under the banner of Maddock Films. It also stars Wamiqa Gabbi, Jaideep Ahlawat, Sikandar Kher, Ashish Vidyarthi, Lalit Prabhakar, and Ritvik Sahore. The film was distributed by Jio Studios.
